name: Pulsar
subtitle: Beat markers for After Effects
description: Pulsar detects beats in your audio, lets you refine them on a waveform, and syncs markers to After Effects.
highlights: Detect and edit beat markers on an interactive waveform with playback preview.
Separate stems with Demucs, then analyze specific tracks for tighter hits.
Sync markers—and optional preview audio—to After Effects via the bundled CEP panel.
